C10.for_what_part: Sent as released shows which sending calls were made, which were confirmed and which were ordered and not confirmed, checked against the release. It does not show that any call left its row in the outbox. A confirmed reply does not say what the call did, and a preview call appends no row. Only trace of a call, asked for on named lines at A3, can show the outbox.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: 1. C3 (category follows the requester's rule): no instrument checks the category against the rule. 2. C5 (the worker reads only approved accounts): this can only be checked with scope of a call on named lines, at 10 per line from an allowance of 50. That covers at most 5 of the roughly 101 reads. 3. C10 (each sending call left its notice in the outbox): this needs trace of a call at 10 per line, and the allowance pays for at most 5 lines. So this check would go to the calls not confirmed and to any that look like previews. I would have wanted an outbox check over all 100 sending calls at once. 4. Same set and summary of the change only read the staged set. No answer reads the live tables after the promotion, so the link from the staged set to the live tables rests on the promotion's line in the record. 5. Nothing checks that the wording read is the approved wording before the A2 release check.
